annotations.title: Take GitHub pull requests out of a stack

description: Take the pull requests out of a native stack, named by its number or by a pull request in it. Every unmerged pull request leaves (open, draft and closed ones); merged and queued ones stay in the stack, and remaining shows what is left, null when the stack is gone. The pull requests stay open with their branches and bases as they were, and nothing is deleted: github_stack_link can build the stack again. A pull request in no stack is left alone: nothing is sent and changed is false. A pull request is 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

pr.description: A pull request in the stack. The pull request, as 12, #12, owner/repo#12 or its URL.

repo.description: owner/name; defaults to the working tree's repository (its origin). Used for a bare number.

stack.description: The stack's number (not a pull request's).

name: github_stack_unlink

changed.description: False when the pull request was in no stack, or none of the stack's pull requests could leave.

base.description: The branch the bottom pull request merges into.

layers.description: The pull requests, bottom to top.

base.description: The base branch name; null in the short form.

position.description: 1 is the bottom of the stack.

title.description: Null when GitHub gave only the short form of the stack (a list).

number.description: The stack's number, which is not a pull request's.

size.description: How many pull requests the stack holds.

remaining.description: What is left of the stack (merged and queued pull requests stay); null when it is gone.

removed.description: The pull requests that left the stack.

stack_number.description: The stack that was taken apart; null when the pull request was in none.
